About.title: About
About.intro: Who I am, how I work and the path that led here: DevOps, cloud and web development, from Marseille.

hero.title: Who am I<accent>?</accent>
hero.p1: I'm Manaud Calixte, a DevOps consultant and developer, passionate about automation, the cloud and building reliable, scalable solutions. I like designing infrastructure that lasts, building useful applications and learning continuously.
hero.p2: My goal: putting technology to work for concrete impact, whether in the cloud, in web development or in integrating solutions such as Salesforce.
